name: 46962 · N Manchester, IN
findings: ZIP 46962 (N Manchester) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46962 (N Manchester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46962 (N Manchester) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 81% of all organizations here have no identified type.
